feeds.title: Horse & Hound Horse and rider training
feeds.description: Horse & Hound offers useful horse training tips and techniques from top riders and trainers to improve your horse. Read latest horse news, learn expert horse care tips & improve your riding with tips from pros. Find your perfect horse, view horse pictures & watch videos.

feeds.title: Straightness Training
feeds.description: Tips and information about horses and horse riding to help you to be the best rider you can be! Here you'll find an extensive knowledge base with tips and articles about straightness training, horseback riding, horse training and more!

feeds.title: Carson James
feeds.description: Ready To Genuinely Understand Your Horse Without Using Gimmicks? You Belong Here. Follow us to quickly start building a rock solid horse-human relationship.

feeds.title: HippoLogic
feeds.description: Turn every training and every ride in the best possible experience for human and horse! Win-Win! My mission is to improve horse-human relationships by educating equestrians about ethical and horse friendly training. I offer coaching to empower you to train your horse in a 100% animal friendly way that empowers both you and your horse.

feeds.title: Horse Trainer Directory
feeds.description: The UK's No 1 Horse Trainer Directory.This free resource details Horse Trainer Websites, Blogs & Twitter Links. Whether potential racehorse owner, race fan or simply want to hear the latest news straight from the horse's mouth. We feature 100s of UK National Hunt & Flat Trainer Websites, Blogs, Facebook & Twitter Links. Plus our NEW track resource.

feeds.title: The Clicker Center Blog
feeds.description: Alexandra teaches clicker training geared to any horse need or sport-including developing a gentle and companionable riding horse, halter training foals, training advanced performance horses, and reforming difficult and unmanageable horses.

feeds.title: Reining Trainers
feeds.description: Creating awareness of the welfare concerns of the reining horse through media to improve their lives with reining trainers.

feeds.title: Stacy Westfall Blog
feeds.description: Like any good trainer, Stacy's aim has always been to have the clearest and precise communication with her horse as possible. Her goal in her reining was to make the reins unnecessary. While others have approximated that goal, Stacy made it a reality. In 2003 she won the National Reining Horse Association Freestyle reining competition riding with no bridle and with not so much as a neck rope.

feeds.title: Lauren Fraser Equine Behaviourist Blog
feeds.description: Lauren Fraser is an experienced horsewoman, who has worked with horses professionally since 2006. She is qualified to help you solve your horse's behavior or training problem, using techniques both you and your horse will feel good about. Find Science-based horse behavior and training articles your horse would want you to read.

feeds.title: Lambourn Trainers Association
feeds.description: The Lambourn Valley, situated in the north-east corner of Berkshire, is recognised as one of the major racehorse training centres in the country. Daily comments on all Lambourn runners, direct from the trainers for free. Latest horse racing news from Lambourn, the Valley of the Racehorse.

feeds.title: Western Austalian Racehorse Trainers Association
feeds.description: The Western Australian Racing Trainers' Association is the peak body representing licensed thoroughbred trainers in WA. The WARTA is committed to assisting trainers in each of the Metropolitan, Provincial and Country racing sectors, and to contribute to the overall success of the West Australian racing industry.

feeds.title: Charle Hills News
feeds.description: As part of the Hills dynasty created by his father Barry, Charlie has spent his entire life immersed in horse racing. Find the latest news and updates related to horse racing and training.

feeds.title: Johnston Racing
feeds.description: Mark Johnston is one of Britain's leading racehorse trainers. Based in Middleham, we have achieved over 100 winners for 24 consecutive seasons. Here at Mark Johnston Racing we recognise and value the importance of the people who make up our team and so we constantly invest significant resources in training and development, encouraging team members to continually develop their skills.

feeds.title: Compassionate Horse Click (CHC) Blog
feeds.description: A simple step-by-step methodology for all stages of training that is sure to resonate with your heart & your horse. Also, find creative guidance & solutions to suit you & your horse's needs. CHC offers online horse training courses & community for those who want to enjoy positively training their own horses.

feeds.title: Bee and the Horse
feeds.description: You are warmly invited to follow my journey in the Academic Art of Riding!. When I started this blog, I was just a regular, first-time horse owner. My horse, Nazir, however, made sure that my childhood passion developed into something much more.

feeds.title: Martin Keighley
feeds.description: We're based in the beautiful and historic setting of Condicote Stables, a short drive from Cheltenham in the heart of the Cotswolds. 'Maker of horses, maker of men', as Alastair Down described him. We follow in his tradition and footsteps, and are proud to do so. We've trained over 200 winners to date, including over 16 winners at Cheltenham.

feeds.title: Jeremy Scott Holworthy Farm Blog
feeds.description: Farmer turned trainer of national hunt horses. Racehorse trainer Jeremy Scott is based in Somerset and trains a team of 50 horses for National Hunt jump racing. With us every horse is an individual, we always have talented youngsters available for sale. We never run a horse before it is ready, on unsafe ground, unschooled, unfit.

feeds.title: Richard Phillips Racing Blog
feeds.description: A National Hunt and Flat racehorse trainer, based in the beautiful village of Adlestrop in the Cotswolds. We hope to give you a taste of the excitement and fun of owning a racehorse.

feeds.title: Micky Hammond Racing
feeds.description: Micky Hammond is one of the top horseracing trainers of his time. The knowledge he has gained being a leading jump jockey combined with his determination and individual approach to training is what makes him get the best out of horses of all levels. Here at Micky Hammond Racing customers can buy horses, part own horses, and pay for entry to racing clubs.

feeds.title: Kinneston
feeds.description: Nick Alexander is a leading racehorse trainer in Scotland based his stables at Kinneston in Scotlandwell near Kinross, Perthshire. Owning all or part of a racehorse is an exciting and rewarding adventure. I train racehorses, used to be mainly slow ones but things looking up!

feeds.title: Alternative Horsemanship with Samantha Harvey
feeds.description: Free horse training ideas and horsemanship philosophies with international equine clinician Sam Harvey. Sam Harvey's website and blog offer insight into her training theories and teaching philosophies. Ask the Trainer forum, lesson and training details, clinic schedule, Hoofprints & Happenings newsletter, facility pictures and much more!

feeds.title: CRK Training LLC Blog
feeds.description: CRK Training Blog is a weekly video blog designed to help you in all areas of riding, horse training, and horse care. Check out my blog for weekly posts on horse care, riding, and training!

feeds.title: Art2ride
feeds.description: Art2Ride has developed an Associate Trainers Program for followers around the world who have studied the system and demonstrated their abilities and understanding of how to systematically develop a horse through the levels. Certified Associate Trainers have been through a rigorous process in which they have to demonstrate their abilities and understanding of Classical Foundation Training.

feeds.title: Comly Sport Horses Blog
feeds.description: Check out the latest news & updates about top sports horse shows in Texas. Articles feature horse training, hunter-jumper training ideas, tips, horse-buying tips, and more. Authored by Happy Comly, Owner & Trainer of Comly Sport Horses. Comly Sport Horses is a well-respected, small business that provides hunter-jumper show horse services in Dallas/Fort Worth and surrounding areas. We can offer you Top-Level Training and Boarding, Horse Show Jumping Experience, and Jumper Horses to Purchase.

feeds.title: Horsemareship | Gentle Horse Trainer Missy Wryn
feeds.description: Where the Gentle Horse Training Movement Begins!! I am a world renowned gentle horse trainer and named horse whisperer who teaches and trains horses humanely without the use of bits and spurs.

feeds.title: Tom George Racing
feeds.description: Racehorse Trainer based in Slad, Gloucestershire. Tom has striven tirelessly to put his experience and intuitive knowledge of the Thoroughbred to good effect for his horses and their owners. Tom has unique insight into the selection of the right conformation and training regimes to win our best Jump races in the UK or in mainland Europe.

feeds.title: David O'Meara Racing
feeds.description: David O'Meara Racing is a unique horseracing stable based in Upper Helmsley on the outskirts of York. Our mission is to get your heart racing

feeds.title: Linda Rice Racing Leading Female Horse Trainer & Bloodstock Agent
feeds.description: From wins and training titles to awards & earnings, Linda Rice is known in thoroughbred industry as the most decorated female trainer in history. Linda Rice has been one of the top ten trainers in New York for the last decade and holds the designation of leading female trainer in the United State.

feeds.title: Damian English Racehorse Trainer
feeds.description: Damian English is a young racehorse trainer based in North County Dublin, this page will keep you updated with runners and some behind the scenes photos. Damian English is noted for his unique ability to turn a bargain into gold dust.

feeds.title: Brian Meehan Racing
feeds.description: Welcome to our website - one that has unrivalled information and news for all of the horses trained by Brian Meehan at Manton House Estate in Wiltshire, UK. Our focus is to effectively communicate with our owners, the media and fans throughout the season via regular posts, news and video updates provided by Sirecam Europe.

feeds.title: Happy Horse Training ...go the WHOLE way!
feeds.description: Happy Horse Training promotes Holistic Horsemanship in every meaning of the word, including physiological dressage training without force.

feeds.title: Training Barrel Horses
feeds.description: The most diverse barrel horse training video library. Sheena Robins with Best Ever Pads explains how she warms up both her rodeo and her futurity horses.

feeds.title: CowgirlDiary
feeds.description: CowgirlDiary is the perfect venue to share my passion for horses, the daily joys and struggles of training a horse from the basics on up, recount my childhood memories with horses, and make friends with those who have the common interest of horses.

feeds.title: FunHorseTraining - BLS Horsemanship
feeds.description: In our BLS Horsemanship Blog, we, Ben & Linda, share horse training tips, success stories of our clients, info about upcoming events, a little bit about us, photos, free horse training videos, problem solving tips and much more. Our horse training methods and philosophy have helped hundreds of horse owners develop a better understanding of their horses, overcome adversity with knowledge.

feeds.title: HorseTraining Channel
feeds.description: The Horse Training Channel is for people who are serious about making progress. But, most importantly, to you and your success, not only can Cleve train horses...but he can train people. Our mission is to help you Make Every Ride Count towards accomplishing your goals with your horse by teaching and reminding you of the fundamentals of competitive training.

feeds.title: Horse Canada - Canada's Premier Horse Lifestyle
feeds.description: Horse Canada is an all-breed, multi-discipline magazine with emphasis on equine health and well-being. It is a family-friendly horse magazine for western and English riding enthusiasts, providing essential advice and practical tips on health, care, behaviour and training, plus news of interest, industry trends and inspirational stories from the Canadian horse community.

feeds.title: Talking To Horses
feeds.description: Talking to horses offers useful horse training tips and techniques. This blog can help you as the trainer, the coach, or the student to deal with problems in both coaching, riding, and training horses.

feeds.title: Ivy's Glide Gait Train a Smooth Gait Naturally Blog
feeds.description: I believe in training gaited horses to gait as smoothly as possibly while helping them stay as relaxed as possible. Blog by Ivy Schexnayder.

feeds.title: Jec Ballou Blog
feeds.description: Welcome! Jec A. Ballou brings riders and horses measurable progress - while avoiding boredom, confusion, or injury - though correct physical conditioning of the horse. Her training emphasizes science-based exercises to improve movement and performance.

feeds.title: Balanced Rider Blog
feeds.description: My blog is about teaching, riding and training. I share what is important to me in my work with horses and riders. The writing helps me to think things over and have a better understanding of training ideas and priciples.

feeds.title: Virtual Horse Help
feeds.description: Virtual Horse Help brings you free horse training videos from top professionals and takes you behind the scenes at major equestrian events. We invite you to join us as we take online training and the new age of the online equestrian experience to a new level.

feeds.title: Connection Training Blog
feeds.description: Connection Training is also a philosophy, where we aim to change the way people see horses and how they work with them, moving towards an approach which is fun, fair, successful and achievable for horses and humans alike. Find teaching resource that will help you to train your horse in a way that is fun and rewarding for you both.

feeds.title: Fergal O'Brien Racing
feeds.description: National Hunt Racehorse Trainer based at the Upper Yard at Grange Hill Farm in the Cotswolds. Fergal, assistant trainer Sally Randell, head lad Kev Brown and a great team of stable staff managed to get 60 winners on the scoreboard, with prize money in excess of £610K.

feeds.title: Horsefulness Training
feeds.description: Train your horse in a gentle & clear way. Get a happy and cooperative horse using Liberty Training, Groundwork, Gymnastic Groundwork & Bitless Riding Art.
